verdict.rationale: Data export applies to an email-marketing SaaS, but the pack documents no export feature such as a CSV or JSON download of contacts, campaigns or reports, and no account-exit path. The only related evidence is a JSON API that returns paginated contact collections. That is a developer building block for constructing an export, not the product's own export capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
